description:
Up to 10 areas side by side on up to 8 published metrics, one basis line. Use
    it for "compare W14 with E5 on rent and yield". `areas` is a list of
    {"type": "postcode_district" | "local_authority" | "county" | "country",
    "code": ...}; codes as in resolve_place. Free text is refused.

    Each row is one area, and an area that cannot be read is its own row with
    covered=false and a reason (the call is covered if at least one row answered).
    Months can differ between areas: read each figure's `period`. Asking-to-sold
    and days on market are hidden where fewer than 10 sales matched; days on
    market is only observed from Sep 2026. Do NOT use it as a valuation.

    More than 10 areas or 8 metrics is refused. Free; covered=false or an upstream
    failure is not charged. Free.
name: compare_areas
title: Compare areas side by side
